question: Which additional female figures are included among those who know through devotion on earth?
premises: The preceding verses enumerate female figures who know through devotion on earth.
This verse names ulukī, pecakī, sararī, and gūlī as further figures.
The particles vā and tathā mark these names as alternatives or additions to the same list.
inference: Ulukī, pecakī, sararī, and gūlī are likewise included among the female figures who know through devotion on earth.
uncertainties: The precise identity or mythic background of sararī and gūlī is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The owl-woman, the peacock-woman, or indeed the sarari-woman, or the guli-woman, likewise.
